name: Braised Lamb Shank
description: Braised lamb shank with creamy mashed potato and a butter bean and chorizo sauce.
plating: Shank stood upright on a bed of mash, with the bean and chorizo sauce spooned around one side and a pile of greens and rocket on the other. Finished with a balsamic drizzle and crispy onion crumb on a speckled stoneware plate.

name: Burrata, Parma Ham and Gnocco Fritto
description: Starter of burrata with Parma ham and gnocco fritto.
plating: Burrata opened on a dark plate with folds of Parma ham around it, herb oil and greens over the top, and the gnocco fritto laid alongside.

name: Gnocchi with Beef, Mushrooms and Red Wine
description: Gnocchi with beef and mushrooms in a red wine sauce, topped with a gorgonzola cream.
plating: Served in a patterned bowl, finished with grated cheese and micro herbs.

name: Lobster Tagliatelle
description: Tagliatelle with lobster in a spicy tomato sauce.
plating: Tagliatelle twisted onto a speckled stoneware plate, with the lobster tail and claws set over the top and finished with fresh basil.

name: 20oz T-Bone Steak
description: 20oz T-bone steak with herby truffle fries, mushroom pasta and peppercorn sauce.
plating: Steak sliced on a wooden board with rocket and shaved cheese, with the mushroom pasta and peppercorn sauce served alongside in their own pots.

name: Rack of Lamb
description: Rack of lamb on a butternut squash puree with cubed potatoes and sauteed spinach, finished with a blueberry sauce.
plating: Squash puree swept across the plate, potatoes and greens on top, then the lamb cutlets stacked with bones up and the blueberry sauce spooned over. Finished with toasted seeds.

name: Lobster Ravioli with Langoustines
description: Lobster-filled ravioli in a prawn and 'nduja sauce, topped with langoustines.
plating: Ravioli and prawns in the sauce on a white plate, with the langoustines laid over the top and finished with pea shoots.

name: Whole Stuffed Sea Bass
description: A whole boneless sea bass, stuffed and roasted, served with crushed potatoes tossed with mint and peas, a saffron salad and topped with salsa verde.
plating: The whole fish laid across the plate with the salsa verde spread along the top, and the minted pea potatoes served alongside.

name: Seafood Mixed Grill
description: A mixed grill of assorted seafood. The selection and price change depending on the fish available.
plating: Served in a large pan for sharing, piled with mussels, squid rings and king prawns, with samphire and cherry tomatoes through it.

name: Pan-Seared Cod
description: Pan-seared cod on a bed of parsnip puree with pan-seared leek and a red pepper sauce.
plating: Cod set on a round of parsnip puree with the charred leek leaning against it, the pepper sauce spooned over the fish and a tall nest of pea shoots on top.

name: Gnocchi with Beef, Mushrooms and 'Nduja
description: Gnocchi with beef and mushrooms in a spicy 'nduja cream sauce, topped with 'nduja cream and chilli flakes.
plating: Served on a speckled stoneware plate, dotted with 'nduja cream and finished with chilli flakes, grated cheese and pea shoots.

name: Honey Roast Ham Pizza
description: Pizza with our house-made honey roasted ham on a white base, topped with gorgonzola, walnuts and hot honey.
plating: Finished with cracked black pepper and chilli flakes.
